static_traits.name: Lin Hui
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to confide in, but they do not understand her degree of Fear about cycling
static_traits.medical_history: Similar psychological problems not yet appeared before; not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent narration, high cooperativeness, able to describe events and emotional experiences concretely, reporting Significant anxiety feelings

basic_info.main_problem: After a crash on a gravel road six months ago, developing Fear of cycling, having completely stopped cycling, even feeling Anxious at the thought of cycling.
basic_info.core_demands: I am seeking counseling because this fear significantly affects my ability to enjoy the activities I love and causes distress in daily life.
growth_experiences: Six months ago losing control and crashing while cycling on a gravel road, experiencing intense Fear. Since then seeing bicycles or attempting to cycle brings Anxiety and racing heart, completely stopping cycling to avoid another injury, and firmly believing she would crash again no matter where she cycled.
In the past, when learning to swim, felt afraid, but after gradual practice her ability rose, finally overcame the fear and enjoyed swimming.

core_beliefs: I am vulnerable and unsafe while cycling (very likely to get hurt)

special_situations.event: Seeing a bicycle or trying to ride one
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I ride again, I will definitely fall and get injured again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoids cycling, stays away from cycling-related places and topics

special_situations.event: Passing gravel roads where accidents happened before or similar road conditions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A crash on a gravel road means cycling anywhere is dangerous
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids all possible riding environments, especially road conditions similar to the accident
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nowhere is safe, I will lose control

special_situations.event: Being triggered by memories at places she used to cycle or seeing others cycle
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I come into contact with cycling-related cues, I will relive the fear and pain of that time
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Deflecting attention, circumventing related scenes and crowds
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Having to relive that terrible experience

special_situations.event: Thinking about trying cycling again or being invited to make a gradual practice plan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If absolute safety, completely without Fear cannot be guaranteed, should not start trying
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitates, procrastinates or refuses to start any small-step attempt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do it, better not to cycle

core_conflict.wish: Longs to feel safe again and enjoy cycling and daily activities once more
core_conflict.fear: Fearing loss of control and injury; worrying the trauma will recur
defense_goal: Maintaining safety and reducing Anxiety by avoiding cycling and related cues

object_relations.object_representation: Cycling situations / roads as dangerous and unpredictable external objects

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing a bicycle, passing places once cycled, or discussing a plan to return to cycling in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views the present cue as imminent danger, believing 'I will definitely crash again' (equating the current situation with past trauma)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle, steady tone first Empathize with her Fear and caution, avoiding authoritarian lecturing; using open-ended questions to explore the cost of avoidance and the safety she wants, inviting her to describe present body sensations and images, and only introducing the possibility of small-step exposure with her permission.

manifestations: Limits choices and range of action due to fear; avoids contact with cycling and related settings
Becoming hesitant about trying other activities too, worrying about possible bad consequences
outcomes: Reduced enjoyment of life and autonomy
Overall Anxiety level rising, more negative Anticipation about the future

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently telling herself 'I cannot do it, better not to cycle' to self-limit attempts
Marked hesitation and Withdrawal when discussing small-step attempts, tending to prioritize risk avoidance

exception_events.target_problem: When facing activities that cause Fear, Lin Hui usually avoids for safety, thus missing chances to gradually adapt and recover enjoyment.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When Learning to swim in the past, initially very afraid, but gradually improving through practice and starting to enjoy swimming, unlike past avoidance.
exception_events.reason: Clues: adopted a gradual practice approach and accumulated successful experiences, so this time the fear was reduced and confidence gradually built.

positive_force: Has had the experience of overcoming fear and gaining enjoyment through practice (learning to swim)
Willing to seek help and start counseling
Able to identify and express her own Anxiety and trigger cues
negative_force: Thinking patterns like catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization maintaining Fear
Uses avoidance as the main coping strategy, reducing stress short-term but maintaining the problem long-term
Insufficient Social support understanding of her Fear

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding cycling and cycling-related cues, and experiencing Significant anxiety on contact with cues (racing heart, tension, catastrophic associations)
antecedent: Passing places where one once rode or where accidents happened
Imagining / planning another ride in one's mind
target_behavior.core_reason: A crash experience forming conditioned Fear, with Anxiety maintained by catastrophic predictions of 'crashing again no matter where' and overgeneralized beliefs
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome things (potential danger and Anxiety), to gain immediate safety and tension relief
target_behavior.consequence: Unable to do beloved cycling and other physical activities, Decreased enjoyment of life; Anxiety maintained and generalized, more hesitant about other activities too
